laneStatuses.summary: Confirmed official identity as Sjuhäradsleden etapp 9. Borås coordinates are Böne kyrka 6416620 412026 and Årås säteri 6416792 419809; Naturkartan GPX/API route endpoints are 57.8825367,13.515455 and 57.8855858,13.6471716. No official KML found. Audited Naturkartan GPX/API and OSM relation 5607244. Naturkartan GPX has 312 points, one track/segment, computed 11.438 km, endpoints 57.8825367,13.515455 to 57.8855858,13.6471716, no >500 m gaps and direction Böne to Årås. Naturkartan API site 21675 has one MultiLineString member, 256 vertices and 11.437 km, with publish_gpx=false despite valid public GPX. OSM relation has 13 member ways, assembled length 11.415 km and no >1 m gaps when ways are oriented by connectivity; two member ways are stored opposite traversal direction. Naturkartan and OSM endpoints agree within 1-3 m. No section-9 overlap with Åsundenleden or Redvägsleden; Änglaleden shares about 311 m near Knätte/Stacksåsen.

Found section 9 facility candidates: Böne kyrka and Böne parking/info at start; Knätte kyrka as a short-side-detour official/heritage POI; Varpaledet badplats with dry toilet, jetties, swings, grill, tables/benches and changing rooms plus nearby parking; Struntfiskeboa shelter/basic hut and adjacent firepit near Jogen; Årås parking/info, Årås kvarn/Trädgårdscafé and Årås kvarn vandrarhem/Mejeriet endpoint services. No confirmed public drinking water, waste bin, campsite or bus stop on the stage; Årås toilets/water are guest/customer metadata unless public access is verified. Redvägsleden facilities are off section 9 and should be suppressed here.

Confirmed Böne kyrka has no practical fixed-route public transport at the trailhead. Closest useful fixed bus is Dalum on Västtrafik line 209, about 3.5 km straight-line from Böne; Böne Storegården 141 appears eligible for Västtrafik Närtrafik about 0.1 km from the church. Årås säteri/Årås kvarn also has no practical fixed-route public transport; nearest fixed bus options are roughly 10 km+ straight-line away, but Årås Säteri appears eligible for Ulricehamn Närtrafik about 0.13 km from Årås kvarn. Useful intermediate Närtrafik address candidates include Knätte Slättåsen, Knätte Kättestorp and Knätte Kärnås. Närtrafik is Monday-Friday only in fixed time windows and must be pre-booked.

Found direct 2025-05-22 E1 field report published 2025-08-29: Böne kyrka was locked and churchyard water was signed not drinkable; heavy rain/cold conditions; Jogen swim changing-room building gave dry shelter; near Vållern/Årås mill a nature-reserve area had a wind shelter; the day was mostly roads with off-road walking around Årås/Vållern. Older Komoot 2019 report confirms easy walking and that Årås STF hostel was closed in pre-season then; current Årås lodging exists but should be booked/confirmed. Flickr photos from 2024-08-03 support rural/farm/livestock character. No current section-9 trail closure/reroute report found.

Confirmed section 9 finish enters Årås naturreservat. Årås rules prohibit fires, unleashed dogs, damaging/removing dead wood or living vegetation, collecting mosses/lichens/insects/fungi except edible fungi, digging plants, and motor vehicles off roads; caravans/campers may not be set up outside parking. Länsstyrelsen reports no current site news and yearly grazing by sheep/cattle. Ulricehamn local ordinance treats hiking trails, beaches, parks, cemeteries and exercise tracks as public/equivalent places, with camping only at designated campsites and dogs leashed. Varpaledet/Jogen bathing water had 2025 samples listed as tjänligt/no bloom, with no 2026 bathing-season samples found as of 2026-04-29. No official current section-9 closure/reroute, forestry or hunting closure found; refresh fire-ban and field notices before import.

laneStatuses.summary: Confirmed official identity as Sjuhäradsleden etapp 10. Borås uses Årås säteri to Hotell Mullsjö with 22 km, 5.5 hours and Medium; Naturkartan uses 21.3 km and API 21.2 km. Mullsjö describes the same final/tenth stage in reverse from Hotel Mullsjö via Södra Vätterleden/Ryfors/Trollsjön to Årås kvarn. Confirmed official GPX/API, Borås PDF map, Södra/Västra Vätterleden connector context and protected-area source set for Årås/Ryfors/Stråken.

Audited Naturkartan API/GPX, OSM relation 5607240 and E1 Hiking Europe GPX. Naturkartan is continuous in official Årås-to-Hotell-Mullsjö order at about 21.24 km. OSM is topologically continuous but member order is Hotel-to-Årås despite from/to tags; endpoints agree within 3-12 m but local Naturkartan-vs-OSM deviations reach about 80-103 m. E1 publishes the stage in reverse. Confirmed overlaps with Änglaleden, Ryforsleden, Södra Vätterleden and Mullsjö Runt.

Found section 10 facility candidates: Årås trailhead/parking and STF Årås lodging/heritage, Struntfiskeboa shelter/firepit candidate, EJ Farm, Ryfors Golfklubb/ställplats, Ryfors Smedja, Ryfors reserve parking/toilet/waste, Ryfors Gammelskog, Stråkensbro, Trollsjön rastplats, Stråken naturbad, Gyljeryd heritage POIs, Grillplats nära Mullsjö, Mullsjö Camping, Hotell Mullsjö ledentré/bus, Mullsjö Hotell & Konferens and Mullsjö C access metadata.

Confirmed Årås has no practical fixed-route public transport at the trailhead; best access is parking/drop-off or pre-booked Västtrafik Närtrafik if the Årås/Kölingared address is accepted. Dalum/Spångängen fixed stops are 10 km+ straight-line away. Hotell Mullsjö has strong endpoint public transport via JLT bus 116 at Mullsjö Friluftshotellet and rail/bus via Mullsjö Resecentrum plus an orange access trail.

Found direct 2025 E1 field account and FKT/community reports confirming the section is mostly minor roads, gravel/clay roads, packed dirt and asphalt, with the final roughly 6 km on forest trail into Mullsjö. Wet/sleet weather made the route unpleasant and one hiker personally shortcut the final approach, but no formal closure/reroute was reported. Årås lodging was reported in use in 2025 but remains seasonal/booking-dependent.

Confirmed Årås naturreservat rules, Ryfors gammelskog/Ryfors reserve rules and Stråkens strandskogar rules. Årås and Ryfors prohibit fires; Ryfors also prohibits tenting/caravans. Stråkens permits fire only at designated sites with brought firewood. Confirmed dynamic municipal fire-ban caveat, local camping/dog rules, no section-10 closure/reroute and nearby Ryforsleden/Stråkenleden notices that should not be treated as Sjuhäradsleden closures.
